label: Data table
description: A dense, keyboard-navigable list of records of one entity with sortable columns, server-side paging, and inline property editing. Rows only include records the viewer may read; columns the viewer may not see are omitted. Columns are child nodes (collection.column), so they can be inserted, moved, and removed like any other node.
usage: Use as the main element of list pages; keep 4–8 columns.
Add a column by inserting a collection.column child with an anchor (after the column it follows).
Combine with collection.filter_bar and collection.saved_views in the same section.
constraints: Children must be collection.column nodes referencing existing fields of the entity.
pageSize is 25, 50, or 100; results are always paged on the server.
Authorization is applied before paging and counting; restricted rows and values never reach the client.

entity.description: Entity ID whose records are listed.

filter.description: Base filter expression (CEL subset over record), e.g. record.status != 'closed'.

binding.description: Runs a typed, permission-filtered record query for the entity.

accessibility.keyboard: Arrow keys move between cells, Enter opens the row, E edits the focused cell, J/K move between rows.
accessibility.notes: Sortable headers expose aria-sort. Row count and paging are announced in a live region.

responsive: Below 720px the table becomes a stacked list showing the first three columns per row.
